Driver:hughes (Hughes): Hughes qualified in second at the Monaco ePrix and finished the race in fifth place.

RaceResult:taylor barnard at monaco eprix (Taylor Barnard at Monaco ePrix): Barnard finished his debut race at the Monaco ePrix.

Driver:rast (Rast): Rast finished in seventeenth after suffering from multiple collisions.
A driver who left McLaren.
GrandPrix:berlin eprix (Berlin ePrix): An electric race where Barnard finished Race 1 in tenth.
Team:maserati msg racing (Maserati MSG Racing): A Formula E team that Hughes joined.
